name: wattsteer-monorepo
description: WattSteer — renewable curtailment intelligence for the Brazilian grid (API, web app, shared core).

scripts.test: bun run test:hygiene && bun run --cwd packages/core test && bun run --cwd apps/api test && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/ui typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.ml:lint: cd apps/ml && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.ml:fix: cd apps/ml && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.check:ml: bun run ml:lint && bun run ml:typecheck && bun run ml:test
scripts.check:all: bun run check && bun run check:ml
